text:
alex: Heads-up — PR 14288 is ready for cross-team review. It's a small fallback routing change for canary behavior when GPU pool is constrained. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/pr/14288

alex: This touches runtime routing (router/orch), platform canary config, a tiny KMS handshake tweak (security), and the evictor tuning (infra).

taylor: Thanks — can you call out the main risk? Will this touch in-flight requests or the KV cache?

alex: Should be safe. Fallback path switches new requests to a compatible model variant; no KV cache invalidation. In-flight requests continue on current workers. Main risk is a transient latency bump on failover. I added a canary flag: `orch.canary_fallback.enabled=false` by default.

sam: pinging @runtime-team @platform-team @infra for approvals. @jin @lia can you take a look?

jin: I'll review the runtime diff today — main area is `router/fallback.go`. Quick scan looks straightforward.

lia: I'll validate infra changes (autoscaler/eviction) — likely ok but will sanity-check metrics and thresholds.

taylor: looping in @security for the KMS tweak — @olivia, can you do a quick eyes on perms/audit impact?

olivia: On it. If it's just a handshake timeout and a key access callsite this week, should be quick. Will check audit implications.

alex: Reviewer assignment request: runtime: @jin, platform: @sam, infra: @lia, security: @olivia. Proposed merge window: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Canary: 30m then scale.

sam: small ask — include this canary runbook snippet in the PR description:
```
canary:
  duration: 30m
  checks:
    - latency_p95 < 250ms
    - error_rate < 0.5%
    - kv_spill_rate == 0
```

alex: Added the runbook to the PR description and the deploy ticket.

jin: Left two tiny comments on `router/fallback.go` (nit + test). Will push fixes before EOD.

lia: infra LGTM pending a metric rename (kv_spill_rate -> kv_spill_events). I'll push a changelist.

olivia: security: OK with change, please add a KMS audit log note to the deploy docs and confirm key usage principals.

taylor: Great — if all reviewers mark LGTM by 08:30 PT tomorrow we can merge at 09:00 PT and run the canary.

alex: Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploy-bot: Merge checklist updated — reviewers requested, awaiting LGTMs.
